beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: In this town, everybody goes out partying.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Except me.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Pool parties. Foam parties.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Even a birthday party for the mayor's pigeon.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: My grandad crowd-surfs on Wednesdays.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: But not me. I play chess.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I don't eat breakfast. I sacrifice it.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: My cat only moves in L-shapes now.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then came the Summer Party Chess Match.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Everybody laughed. Some goon yelled,

beats.speaker: heckler
beats.text: Who brings a chess clock to a party?

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: My opponent? The mayor. Undefeated for forty years. Top ten scariest opponents.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Checkmate. In four moves. Respect.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The whole crowd went silent.

beats.speaker: marcus
beats.text: When did you get so good?

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: While you were out partying.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Now the whole town is grinding.

beats.speaker: town
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: My grandad plays blindfolded. He just lost his glasses. Bro.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: And my only opponent left is the mayor's pigeon.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Honestly? He's winning.

beats.speaker: pigeon
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Respect.
